Flip: Finds items in Europe to sell on Cerberus.
Searches the last 24 hours for at least 5 sales, an average price of at least 1,500 gil, candidate profit of at least 1,000 gil and 40% ROI.
Requires at least 3 sales in 7 days.
Profit per unit must be positive after 5% buyer tax and 5% seller tax and travel costs, with sellable quantity capped at 3 days of sales.
High margin: Finds items in Europe to sell on Cerberus.
Searches the last 24 hours for at least 5 sales, an average price of at least 5,000 gil, candidate profit of at least 5,000 gil and 40% ROI.
Searches the last 72 hours for at least 3 sales, an average price of at least 5,000 gil, candidate profit of at least 5,000 gil and 40% ROI.
Requires at least 4 sales in 7 days, at least 4 distinct buyers and sales on at least 3 days.
Profit per unit must be at least 12,000 gil after 5% buyer tax and 5% seller tax and travel costs, with sellable quantity capped at 3 days of sales.
Volume: Finds items in Europe to sell on Cerberus.
Searches the last 24 hours for at least 5 sales, an average price of at least 3,000 gil, candidate profit of at least 3,000 gil and 40% ROI.
Searches the last 72 hours for at least 3 sales, an average price of at least 3,000 gil, candidate profit of at least 3,000 gil and 40% ROI.
Requires at least 4 sales in 7 days, at least 8 distinct buyers, sales on at least 4 days and at least 2.5 units/day.
Profit per unit must be at least 6,000 gil after 5% buyer tax and 5% seller tax and travel costs, with sellable quantity capped at 3 days of sales.
Snipe: Finds items in Europe to sell on Cerberus.
Searches the last 24 hours for at least 5 sales, an average price of at least 3,000 gil, candidate profit of at least 3,000 gil and 40% ROI.
Searches the last 72 hours for at least 3 sales, an average price of at least 3,000 gil, candidate profit of at least 3,000 gil and 40% ROI.
Searches the last 168 hours for at least 3 sales, an average price of at least 5,000 gil, candidate profit of at least 4,000 gil and 100% ROI.
Requires at least 3 sales in 7 days.
Profit per unit must be positive after 5% buyer tax and 5% seller tax and travel costs, with sellable quantity capped at 3 days of sales.
Snipe alerts require a listing at or below 50% of the Cerberus 7-day median, at least 5,000 gil profit per unit, at least 3 buyers, a sale less than 24 hours ago and a top buyer share of at most 50%.
Fresh listings aged 0 to under 1 hours appear in the app and Discord when enabled.
Stale listings aged 1 to under 6 hours appear in the app only.
